definitions.explanation: Muscle stiffness and tension in the shoulder and neck area, often caused by poor posture, stress, or desk work.

examples.japanese: {肩凝|かたこ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧。
⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{肩凝|かたこ}りになった。
examples.english: I got stiff shoulders from working on the computer.

examples.japanese: ⟦マッサージ→マッサージ：00272_massaaji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{肩凝|かたこ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}した→解消する：21324_kaishousuru⟧。
examples.english: I relieved my stiff shoulders with a massage.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧ (shoulder) + ⟦{凝|こ}り→凝り：07279_kori⟧ (stiffness) - from ⟦{凝|こ}る→凝る：08180_koru⟧ (to stiffen)

ALTERNATE WRITING:
Also written as {肩|かた}{凝|こ}り or {肩|かた}こり (with hiragana for ⟦{凝|こ}り→凝り：07279_kori⟧)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{肩凝|かたこ}り is an extremely common complaint in Japan, particularly among office workers. Massage parlors, heat patches, and stretching exercises targeting {肩凝|かたこ}り are widely available.

- ⟦{頭痛|ずつう}→頭痛：03369_zutsuu⟧ - headache
- ⟦{寝違|ねちが}え→寝違え：08034_nechigae⟧ - stiff neck from sleeping wrong

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
